svg.text: Inside the app: which agent runs when, the tools each one may call, and the session state they pass along
Plugins on the App · run around every agent, model and tool call in this app
redacts PII · caps calls · refund limit
saves each turn to Memory Bank
LlmAgent · routes by each sub-agent's description
transfers each turn to one sub-agent
no model of its own: runs steps 1 → 2 → 3 in fixed order
LlmAgent · fills the Case schema: intent, order ID, summary
runs the three researchers at the same time
repeats until the reviewer calls exit_loop, at most 3 rounds
IAM only: callers send an ID token
workflow agent: no model, fixed order
